description: This Java class, ConnectionLogUtil, provides utility methods for enhancing and managing logging context (MDC) entries related to connection IDs and correlation IDs, particularly for use with Akka DiagnosticLoggingAdapter instances within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConnectionLogUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing MDC connection and correlation ID entries in loggers, supporting both standard SLF4J MDC and Akka DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithConnectionId
methods.description: Adds a connection ID to the MDC log context.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdAndConnectionId
methods.description: Adds both correlation ID and connection ID to the MDC log context.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithConnectionId
methods.description: Adds a connection ID to a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: removeConnectionId
methods.description: Removes the connection ID from a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdAndConnectionId
methods.description: Adds correlation ID and connection ID to a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter, possibly utilizing headers from a signal.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdAndConnectionId
methods.description: Adds correlation ID and connection ID to a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter, with correlation ID as a string.
